metrics.fact_recall: Automated keyword matching. For each fact, content words are extracted and checked against the email text. Score = fraction of facts where >=50% of their content words appear in the email. Range: 0.0–1.0.
metrics.tone_accuracy: LLM-as-Judge. The judge model rates (1–10) how well the email matches the requested tone, normalised to 0.0–1.0.
metrics.professional_quality: LLM-as-Judge. The judge model rates (1–10) overall email craft: grammar, structure, subject line, length, and call-to-action, normalised to 0.0–1.0.
